feature: Money path — failed payment → dunning ladder → recovery (MSP platform subscription). Drives the REAL msp-billing Stripe handlers + the REAL daily dunning-advance node against an isTestbed MSP subscription and asserts the genuine resulting msp_subscriptions / msps / msp_event_store state after every rung.
notes: Epic #803 (Money-path lifecycle coverage). This covers what money-path-e2e.json does NOT: money-path stops at INITIAL checkout; this exercises the post-purchase failed-payment + dunning + recovery transitions of the ONLY fully-wired Stripe billing state machine in the repo — the MSP platform channel (artifacts/api-server/src/routes/msp-billing-webhook.ts → msp_subscriptions, and the daily worker artifacts/api-server/src/lib/msp-billing-nodes.ts handleMspDunningAdvance).

HOW IT DRIVES REAL CODE (honest boundary): the BuildConsole HTTP harness cannot produce a valid Stripe webhook SIGNATURE, and Stripe-side event generation (renewals, dunning retries) is asynchronous + non-deterministic — so a webhook cannot be driven the normal way from here. Instead the dev-origin-gated testbed endpoint POST /api/admin/testbed/billing-simulate calls the SAME dispatchMspStripeEvent() the production /api/msp/stripe/webhook route calls (one shared switch), and the SAME handleMspDunningAdvance() the daily workflow calls. So the REAL handler logic + REAL DB writes run. The ONLY parts skipped are (a) Stripe signature verification and (b) Stripe's own event emission — neither is drivable from this harness. That is stated plainly rather than faked.

SELF-CONTAINED: the SETUP step (billing-simulate ensureSubscription) idempotently upserts an isTestbed=true MSP + msp_subscription at a fixed stripe_subscription_id ('sub_regression_testbed') to a known baseline (status=active, dunning_state=null) and clears that MSP's msp_event_store rows so the 'exactly one event' assertions start from zero. TEARDOWN re-runs ensureSubscription to restore the baseline. No real customer subscription is reachable; the dev-origin gate (requireDevOrigin / isReplitDevEnvironment, the same REPLIT_DOMAINS check that selects sk_test_) is the outer safety boundary, identical to /api/admin/testbed/reset.

DB ASSERTIONS are real: each VERIFY hits POST /api/admin/deploy/sql-test (single read-only SELECT, Bearer {{SECRET_KEY}}) and asserts the genuine column value (msp_subscriptions.status, .dunning_state, .payment_failed_at; msps.status) or an event-row rowCount — not merely that a call returned 200.

DUNNING LADDER: handleMspDunningAdvance computes daysSince = floor((now - payment_failed_at)/1 day) and advances null → reminder_sent (Day 3) → suspended (Day 7) → access_revoked (Day 14) → archival_flagged (Day 30). advanceDunning back-dates payment_failed_at by paymentFailedDaysAgo then runs the real node; margins (4/8/15/31) are used so each threshold is unambiguously crossed. msps.status flips to 'suspended' at the suspended + access_revoked rungs (suspended_at set once, on first suspend) and stays 'active' at reminder_sent — asserted at each rung.

RECOVERY: invoice.payment_succeeded while in dunning clears dunning_state + payment_failed_at, sets status='active', restores msps.status='active' + suspended_at=null, and writes exactly one msp.subscription.dunning_cleared event — all asserted.

PRECONDITION / Shane To-Do: requires POST /api/admin/testbed/billing-simulate to be deployed (added to admin-testbed.ts this session) and a dev (.replit.dev) origin. NOT run from this authoring environment (no DEPLOY_URL / dev origin / DB reachable here) — Shane runs it against the dev origin. ENV VARS: DEPLOY_URL, SECRET_KEY (= BUILD_TRACKER_INGEST_TOKEN).

apiTests.name: SETUP — ensure the testbed MSP subscription exists at a clean baseline (status=active, dunning=null, event log cleared)
SETUP verify — baseline row is genuinely active in the DB

body.query: SELECT status FROM msp_subscriptions WHERE stripe_subscription_id = 'sub_regression_testbed'

apiTests.name: EXECUTE — invoice.payment_failed (recurring charge declined) through the real dispatcher
VERIFY — subscription is now past_due in the DB (real handlePaymentFailed write)

body.query: SELECT status FROM msp_subscriptions WHERE stripe_subscription_id = 'sub_regression_testbed'

apiTests.name: VERIFY — payment_failed_at (the dunning clock origin) is now set

body.query: SELECT (payment_failed_at IS NOT NULL) AS failed_set FROM msp_subscriptions WHERE stripe_subscription_id = 'sub_regression_testbed'

apiTests.name: VERIFY — exactly one msp.subscription.payment_failed event was recorded

body.query: SELECT e.id FROM msp_event_store e JOIN msp_subscriptions s ON s.msp_id = e.msp_id WHERE s.stripe_subscription_id = 'sub_regression_testbed' AND e.event_type = 'msp.subscription.payment_failed'

apiTests.name: EXECUTE — advance dunning at Day ~4: expect reminder_sent (real handleMspDunningAdvance)
VERIFY — dunning_state is reminder_sent in the DB

body.query: SELECT dunning_state FROM msp_subscriptions WHERE stripe_subscription_id = 'sub_regression_testbed'

apiTests.name: VERIFY — the MSP org is still active at the reminder stage (not yet suspended)

body.query: SELECT m.status FROM msps m JOIN msp_subscriptions s ON s.msp_id = m.id WHERE s.stripe_subscription_id = 'sub_regression_testbed'

apiTests.name: EXECUTE — advance dunning at Day ~8: expect suspended
VERIFY — dunning_state is suspended in the DB

body.query: SELECT dunning_state FROM msp_subscriptions WHERE stripe_subscription_id = 'sub_regression_testbed'

apiTests.name: VERIFY — the MSP org is now suspended (real msps.status write on the suspend rung)

body.query: SELECT m.status FROM msps m JOIN msp_subscriptions s ON s.msp_id = m.id WHERE s.stripe_subscription_id = 'sub_regression_testbed'

apiTests.name: EXECUTE — advance dunning at Day ~15: expect access_revoked
VERIFY — dunning_state is access_revoked in the DB

body.query: SELECT dunning_state FROM msp_subscriptions WHERE stripe_subscription_id = 'sub_regression_testbed'

apiTests.name: EXECUTE — advance dunning at Day ~31: expect archival_flagged
VERIFY — dunning_state is archival_flagged in the DB

body.query: SELECT dunning_state FROM msp_subscriptions WHERE stripe_subscription_id = 'sub_regression_testbed'

apiTests.name: EXECUTE — recovery: invoice.payment_succeeded (the customer's card finally clears) through the real dispatcher
VERIFY — subscription is active again after recovery

body.query: SELECT status FROM msp_subscriptions WHERE stripe_subscription_id = 'sub_regression_testbed'

apiTests.name: VERIFY — dunning_state was cleared to NULL on recovery

body.query: SELECT (dunning_state IS NULL) AS dunning_cleared FROM msp_subscriptions WHERE stripe_subscription_id = 'sub_regression_testbed'

apiTests.name: VERIFY — payment_failed_at was cleared to NULL on recovery

body.query: SELECT (payment_failed_at IS NULL) AS failed_cleared FROM msp_subscriptions WHERE stripe_subscription_id = 'sub_regression_testbed'

apiTests.name: VERIFY — the MSP org was restored to active on recovery

body.query: SELECT m.status FROM msps m JOIN msp_subscriptions s ON s.msp_id = m.id WHERE s.stripe_subscription_id = 'sub_regression_testbed'

apiTests.name: VERIFY — exactly one msp.subscription.dunning_cleared event was recorded on recovery

body.query: SELECT e.id FROM msp_event_store e JOIN msp_subscriptions s ON s.msp_id = e.msp_id WHERE s.stripe_subscription_id = 'sub_regression_testbed' AND e.event_type = 'msp.subscription.dunning_cleared'
